headline: 5 children die with measles symptoms in 24 hours
summary: Nearly 800 new cases of measles-like symptoms reported in a single day, highlighting a worrying surge in child health risks.
details: Five children have died within 24 hours showing symptoms of measles, according to recent reports.
In the same 24-hour period, 796 new patients with measles symptoms were recorded.
One of the deaths occurred in Mymensingh, adding to the national toll.
The sudden spike in cases and fatalities among children has raised significant health concerns across the country.

headline: 250 million trees: PM Tarique launches nationwide afforestation drive
summary: The Prime Minister initiated a five-year campaign to plant 25 crore saplings to preserve the ecosystem and combat climate change impacts.
details: Prime Minister Tarique Rahman has officially launched a nationwide environmental campaign to plant 250 million trees over the next five years.
The premier initiated the massive afforestation drive on Saturday by planting a Garjan sapling at the Malumghat Reserved Forest in Cox's Bazar's Dulahazara.
Environment Minister Abdul Awal Mintoo, Home Minister Salahuddin Ahmed, and other lawmakers joined the ceremony by planting saplings of 11 different tree varieties.
The five-year afforestation project was a core election pledge of the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP), which formed the government after securing an absolute majority in February.
The Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change will oversee the execution of the project to preserve the ecosystem and cushion the country against climate change.
The initial phase of the campaign will see 15 million saplings planted across 149 Upazilas in 49 districts.
caption:
250 million trees in five years. Bangladesh launches a massive nationwide afforestation drive to fight climate change.

Prime Minister Tarique Rahman has officially launched a nationwide environmental campaign to plant 250 million trees over the next five years.

The premier initiated the massive afforestation drive on Saturday by planting a Garjan sapling at the Malumghat Reserved Forest in Cox's Bazar's Dulahazara.

Environment Minister Abdul Awal Mintoo, Home Minister Salahuddin Ahmed, and other lawmakers joined the ceremony by planting saplings of 11 different tree varieties.

The five-year afforestation project was a core election pledge of the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP), which formed the government after securing an absolute majority in February.

The Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change will oversee the execution of the project to preserve the ecosystem and cushion the country against climate change.

The initial phase of the campaign will see 15 million saplings planted across 149 Upazilas in 49 districts.

#Bangladesh #Environment #Afforestation #ClimateChange #GreenBangladesh

Source: bdnews24.com, Dhaka Tribune, Somoy News
